messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The woman stands facing the ocean, then raises both arms overhead and begins to dance, turning her body and swinging her arms before returning to a standing pose.","camera":"The camera is static in a full-body shot from behind, capturing the subject and the horizon.","clothing":"She wears a pink and white gingham crop top with white off-the-shoulder puff sleeves, a black wrap skirt with a yellow floral pattern, and light blue slip-on sneakers with white soles.","hair_color":"Her hair is dark brown.","hairstyle":"Her hair is pulled back into a low, small bun at the nape of her neck.","identity":"A slim woman with a tanned complexion, seen from behind, with her face not visible.","scene":"The setting is an outdoor concrete platform or rooftop overlooking a calm sea under a clear, bright sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a cobblestone city street with storefronts to a bright concrete platform overlooking a calm sea under a clear sky, matching the reference. The woman remains seen from behind in a static full-body shot, wearing the same pink gingham top, white puff sleeves, black floral wrap skirt, and light blue sneakers, and performs a similar dance sequence. Her lighting now appears brighter and more backlit, consistent with the outdoor seaside setting.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the original street scene with the concrete seaside platform environment from the reference, while preserving the woman's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and camera framing/movement, and adapt her lighting to the new environment.
uncertain: Whether the camera framing and movement are exactly preserved, since the source and output both appear static but exact framing cannot be verified frame by frame.
unexpected_changes: The woman's hair appears darker in the output than in the source, though this may be due to the changed lighting and backlighting.
